author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Irvin (shoulder) to throw bullpen Tuesday
desc: Jake Irvin will throw a bullpen on Tuesday.
impact: Irvin has been on the injured list for the past month with a right shoulder strain. He'll continue to progress on the mound.

author: Ari Koslow
title: DJ Herz diagnosed with flexor muscle strain
desc: DJ Herz underwent an MRI that showed a flexor muscle strain.
impact: It is a setback for Herz. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yerry De los Santos recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Yankees recalled Yerry De los Santos from Triple-A.
impact: De Los Santos adds a fresh arm in the Yankees bullpen following Elmer Rodriguez getting optioned on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Slater elects free agency
desc: Austin Slater has elected free agency.
impact: Slater passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will be able to sign with any team.

author: Nate Miller
title: Alan Rangel recalled from minors on Monday
desc: Alan Rangel was called up from Triple-A Lehigh Valley ahead of Monday's game against the Nationals.
impact: Rangel is expected to pitch in bulk relief behind opener Tim Mayza on Monday night. Rangel has made one appearance for the Phillies earlier this season, giving up one run on three hits with five strikeouts over three innings.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bobby Witt Jr. (knee) not in lineup Monday
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. is not in the Royals lineup on Monday against the Rays.
impact: Witt was said to be "feeling better" on Sunday. He remains day-to-day.

author: Nate Miller
title: Tim Mayza to open for Phillies on Monday
desc: Tim Mayza will serve as the opener for the Phillies on Monday night against the Nationals.
impact: Mayza is having an excellent season out of the Philly bullpen, and he will open a game on the mound for the second time this season. The 34-year-old lefty has not allowed an earned run in any of his last eight appearances, allowing eight hits and no walks while striking out eight over 8 2/3 innings in that span.

author: Nate Miller
title: Sandy Leon elects free agency
desc: Sandy Leon has elected to become a free agent.
impact: Designated for assignment last week by the Braves, Leon cleared waivers and was sent to Triple-A. Instead of taking a minor-league assignment, the veteran backstop has opted to enter the free-agent market once again.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Paddack designated for assignment
desc: The Reds designated Chris Paddack for assignment.
impact: Paddack loses his spot on the Reds 40-man roster. He'll head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach Maxwell optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Reds optioned Zach Maxwell to Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Maxwell returns to Triple-A with Pierce Johnson activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julian Garcia has contract selected by Reds
desc: The Reds selected the contract of Julian Garcia.
impact: Garcia posted a 3.03 ERA across 35 2/3 innings in Triple-A this season. He'll now get an opportunity in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Pierce Johnson (elbow) activated from IL
desc: The Reds activated Pierce Johnson from the injured list.
impact: Johnson had been on the injured list since the end of May with right elbow inflammation. He should return to a high-leverage role in the Reds bullpen.

author: Nate Miller
title: Max Meyer placed on bereavement list
desc: Max Meyer was placed on the bereavement list on Monday.
impact: The Marlins called up reliever Zach Brzykcy to take over Meyer's roster spot while the latter is away from the team for a few days. Meyer should be back in time to start a game in St. Louis this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Mancini sent outright by Angels
desc: The Angels sent Trey Mancini outright to Triple-A Salt Lake.
impact: Mancini passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will remain in the Angels organization.

author: Nate Miller
title: Edgar Quero demoted to minors
desc: Edgar Quero was sent down to Triple-A Charlotte on Monday.
impact: With Kyle Teel (hamstring) being activated ahead of Monday's game, Quero will head down to the minors. Quero has had a disappointing season for the White Sox so far, hitting only .187 with an ugly .486 OPS and only three extra-base hits across 172 plate appearances. The 23-year-old switch-hitter will try to rediscover his form at the plate at Triple-A.
